data.one_liner: A Flutter widget for scroll-animated numbers and digits.
data.what_it_does: Provides animated widgets and controllers to display numbers with scrolling digit transitions, custom separators, prefixes, suffixes, and dynamic color changes.
use_when: You need numbers to animate or scroll when their values change (e.g., counters, scores, financial tickers).
You require formatting options like decimal places, thousands separators, and custom padding.
avoid_when: You only need to display static numbers without any transition or animation effects.
strengths: Easy to use with straightforward widget and controller setup.
Supports custom separators, decimal precision, prefix/suffix text, and animated color transitions.
Built-in accuracy calculation with fallback to native arithmetic.
weaknesses: Limited to number scrolling animations and specialized formatting.
Not suitable for general-purpose text animation.
